title: Before any analysis, produce a source capability inventory.

messages.content:
Before any analysis, produce a source capability inventory.

For every source type you believe you can use (web search, web page fetch,
public APIs, file formats, databases, MCP servers/connectors, local
filesystem, anything else), perform ONE minimal live probe and record:
- source / access method
- exact probe performed (query, URL, file)
- result: success, or failure with the exact error
- what you can do with it: read only / parse / compute on / write
- known limits: auth, rate limits, size, formats

Mandatory probes (record failures honestly; if an endpoint has moved,
say so and try to find the current one):
1. Web search: "SSB statistikkbanken befolkning kommune"
2. Fetch JSON: https://www.hvakosterstrommen.no/api/v1/prices/2024/01-15_NO2.json
3. Fetch CSV: https://data.norges-bank.no/api/data/EXR/B.EUR.NOK.SP?format=csv&startPeriod=2024-01-01&endPeriod=2024-01-31
4. SSB PxWeb API: retrieve table metadata for table 07459
5. NVE reservoir statistics (magasinstatistikk): find and call the public API
6. Read a local file of each format you claim to support

Write capabilities.md (table) and capabilities.json.
Do not list any capability you did not successfully probe. Put claimed but
unprobed capabilities in a separate "unverified" section.
I’ll first probe each available source class, then record only verified capabilities and isolate anything untested.

recipe.label: Parse Compute Retry
recipe.code:
import json, csv, io
prices = json.loads(input_0) if isinstance(input_0, str) else input_0
raw_csv = input_1
if isinstance(raw_csv, str) and raw_csv.lstrip().startswith('"'):
    try:
        raw_csv = json.loads(raw_csv)
    except Exception:
        pass
rows = list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(raw_csv), delimiter=';'))
result = [{
  'electricity_json_rows': len(prices),
  'electricity_first_time': prices[0]['time_start'] if prices else None,
  'norges_bank_csv_rows': len(rows),
  'norges_bank_first_period': rows[0]['TIME_PERIOD'] if rows else None,
  'norges_bank_last_period': rows[-1]['TIME_PERIOD'] if rows else None
}]
json.dumps(result)
